newsitem.title: UK: Lothian Pension Fund awards 140 mln stg portfolios.
newsitem.headline: Lothian Pension Fund awards 140 mln stg portfolios.

text.p: Lothian Pension Fund said Tuesday it has given Bank of Ireland Asset Management (UK) and Morgan Grenfell Asset Management (MGAM) mandates to manage 140 million stg in European equities.

Morgan Grenfell has retained a 120 million stg Europe ex-UK portfolio it has managed for more than 10 years and Bank of Ireland has won a new mandate for 20 million stg, Colin Hay of Lothian Pension Fund told Reuters.
"Bank of Ireland's is a high-risk, high-return element but both are actively mandated portfolios," he said.
Both asset management companies will work under four-year, fixed-term contracts.
Morgan Grenfell also manages a 200 million stg UK portfolio for Lothian.
"We are very pleased," said Roger Morris, director at Morgan Grenfell Asset Management, "We think our performance has been excellent."
Bank of Ireland Asset Management (UK) managing director Francis Ellison cited his company's 23.7 percent average return in Europe over the past five years as the principal reason for the new mandate.
